### A regional rail operator publishes its December timetable

The revised timetable adds two evening services on the coastal line from the first week of December. Commuters on the northern branch will see one fewer peak departure, with the change flagged on every platform board.

[Timetable notice](https://news.example.test/rail/december-timetable)

### Battery storage tender opens for regional substations

The state energy planner has opened a tender for grid-scale batteries at four regional substations. Bids close in February, and the planner expects the first contracts to be signed before the winter peak.

[Tender summary](https://news.example.test/energy/substation-storage-tender)

### Council votes to extend the library's weekend hours

The council approved a six-month trial of Saturday and Sunday opening at the central library. Staff will report usage figures to the next budget round before the trial is made permanent.

[Council minutes](https://news.example.test/local/library-weekend-hours)

### Researchers map soil carbon across a river catchment

A university team sampled soil at 240 sites across a single catchment over three seasons. The results suggest that riparian strips hold more carbon than cleared paddocks, which may guide where future planting is funded.

[Study preview](https://news.example.test/science/catchment-soil-carbon)

### Shipping delays ease at the eastern container terminal

Average dwell time at the eastern terminal fell by a day last week after a second crane came back into service. Importers are still advised to allow an extra week for consignments booked through the end of the month.

[Terminal update](https://news.example.test/trade/eastern-terminal-dwell)
